description: Nominale perronhoogten in stations is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Deze dataset toont de nominale perronhoogten voor elk perronspoor op elke halte in het land. De nominale hoogten komen overeen met de theorische hoogte tussen het perron en de spoorstaaf. Coverage: Belgium. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Infrastructuur, Geolocatie. Its keywords are perronhoogtes, perron, perronspoor, spoorstaaf. The portal shows 2026-08-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
